26710.d: The Temple of Light is an ancient structure built by elves to protect the Death Altar.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
For players who have not completed Within the Light, mourner gear is required to enter through the front door in West Ardougne since it is in the basement of Mourner Headquarters. If the player has completed Mourning's End Part II, the crystal trinket is also needed or else the player will be stopped with the message, "A strange force blocks your path", although movement abilities such as Surge can bypass this. The new key is required to enter the dungeon from the basement; it can be found on the Head Mourner's desk in the basement.

For players having completed Within the Light, Eluned gained the ability to enchant crystal teleport seeds that allows teleportation to the Temple of Light in addition to Lletya. This is the quickest way of arriving at the Temple of Light, and none of the mourner gear is required. If the player chooses to have Eluned die in the quest series, she is replaced by Islwyn in Prifddinas. In this case, speaking to Islwyn will enchant the crystal teleport seed.

Alternatives without Mourner gear would be to go through:
• The Underground Pass from West Ardougne.
• Arandar, south-west of Tree Gnome Stronghold to the western entrance of Underground Pass.
• Lletya, using a crystal teleport seed, exit and then travel north to the western entrance of Underground Pass.
• Down the stairs out the east gate of Prifddinas to the undercity, then through the portal to the Temple

Players then proceed to the dwarf camp at the southern wall, and use the tunnel to the Death altar. This method can only be used if players have completed Mourning's End Part II and talked to the dwarf at the altar about the tunnel. Alternatively, if the players have finished Within the Light, they can teleport to the temple using a crystal seed. The player could also enter the Abyss, go to the death rift, and then use the portal to teleport next to the altar. Using a death altar teleport to teleport into the altar is also a viable option.

26718.d: Temple Trekking is a minigame in which players must escort victims of vampyre rule from Burgh de Rott through Morytania to Paterdomus, which requires completion of the In Aid of the Myreque quest.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
Temple Trekking starts at the town of Burgh de Rott by the northern gate. Start the minigame by reading the noticeboard nearby.

Burgh de Rott Ramble starts on the east side of the River Salve just outside Paterdomus. A player can start on either side.

There are several ways to reach Canifis or Burgh de Rott quickly where the minigame may be started. Some of these include:
• Drakan's medallion teleport to Burgh de Rott (requires partial completion of The Branches of Darkmeyer).
• Games necklace teleport to Burgh de Rott (requires completion of The Darkness of Hallowvale). 
• Kharyrll Teleport (requires completion of Desert Treasure and 66 Magic).
• Fairy ring code CKS (requires partial completion of A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen quest and getting permission from the Fairy Godfather and at least a dramen staff if A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift and Lunar Diplomacy are not completed).
• Teleport to Canifis via the Canifis lodestone and enter the long cave through the trapdoor behind the pub for exit near the rowboat to Mort'ton.
• Teleport to the Slayer Tower just north of Canifis using a slayer ring.

gt.heading: Routes
gt.text:
Once you have chosen a companion to escort, you will need to choose which path to take. There are three paths, each a different difficulty, with the main difference being the combat level of the monsters faced. The path you choose will only affect the difficulty of the next event you face, and after each encounter, you will be given the option of changing paths. Choosing the best path will be dependent upon combat level, available gear and which character is being escorted.

At a certain companion level, your companion will be able to predict upcoming events when you choose the "Continue-trek" option. You can tell your companion has gained this ability because they will run along with you as opposed to walking behind, and in some companions it is also accompanied by a significant change in appearance. If you choose to disable prediction hints, they can be turned back on by speaking to Hiylik Myna in Burgh De Rott.
• Easy route: The monsters on this path are lower level, and combat events will have a minimum of two enemies. To evade any combat event, players must kill at least one monster. Tier 40 armour should be a minimum for this route.
• Medium route: Combat events will have a minimum of three enemies, and to evade them, the player must complete at least 33% of the event first. Prayer may be useful for certain events depending on the player's level, so choosing pure defence or prayer armour will be at the player's discretion.
• Hard route: Combat events will have a minimum of four enemies, and there is sometimes no way to evade an event. The monsters are high-level, so prayer will be important to surviving this route at low levels and having prayer potions is recommended. If escorting a hard companion, certain events such as the swamp snake and giant snail events are particularly difficult: multiple monsters will attack your companion extremely fast and can deliver a significant amount of damage in a very short period.

26771.d: Terror dogs are found at the end of Tarn's Lair.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The lair's entrance is found in the Abandoned Mine and requires a salve amulet to enter. The fastest way to access the lair is to use the ring of slaying and selecting the 'Tarn's Lair' option, which teleports directly into the dungeon (salve amulet not required), with Tarn's room being directly north of the teleport spot.

The second fastest way is using Drakan's medallion to teleport to Burgh de Rott and then heading west to use the Agility shortcut to climb over the fence, climb over the cart, and enter the cart tunnel to enter the Abandoned Mine.

The third way is to teleport to Canifis, and go via the Myreque shortcut to Burgh de Rott. There is an Agility shortcut between the town of Burgh de Rott and the Abandoned Mine area.

Another route is the Burgh de Rott Ramble. Choose Pazuzu (strongest follower), and route 1, the easiest.

To enter the lair, climb over the mine cart just south of the Zealot (featured in the Haunted Mine quest), and enter the Abandoned Mine, then travel north and enter the lair.

If players travel through Tarn's Lair, it is recommended to wear magic defensive armour, or bring prayer potions as the skeleton mages' magic attacks can hit hard. Before entering the room with the terror dogs, remember to equip melee armour.

26820.d: The Arc is a region within the Wushanko Isles, west of The Skull in the Archipelago, that is also visited in the player-owned port.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The player must have completed the quest Impressing the Locals to access the Arc. They can then reach the first island in the Arc, Waiko, by chartering the ship Sarim's Revenge by talking to Mister Gully, who can be found opposite the pub at the north end of Port Sarim.

After the first time, the ship can be taken by talking to Quartermaster Gully at Port Sarim. The Arc journal has a teleport option to the spot. Alternatively, if Arc teletabs are unlocked and purchased, the Arc Journal can be used to teleport to various islands directly.

26828.n: The Barrows: Rise of the Six
26828.page: The Barrows: Rise of the Six
26828.d: The Barrows: Rise of the Six is an enhanced version of the original Barrows Brothers.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The entrance to the fight is located in a well, just west of the entrance to the Barrows, that is surrounded by four outbuildings (do not cross bridges). The quickest way to get there is using Drakan's medallion, which is unlocked during the quest The Branches of Darkmeyer. Alternatively, players may travel through the Hollows and use the swamp boat, which is unlocked after completion of the quest Nature Spirit. Teams of four can use the Grouping System, though one player must have a Barrows totem with them.
